scenes.vo_text: A safety net for control towers. Agents hear every radio call, log it in MongoDB Atlas, and stop conflicting clearances.
Same calls, Safety on. ElevenLabs transcribes each call into Atlas. A change stream fires our rules. No LLM decides. The stop goes to the runway's controller, and {product} says it on the radio.
Every agent is auditable. Agents can only file intents; anything else is blocked and logged. Switch an agent off, and its next intent is refused. Then rewind the whole event from stored records.
scenes.title: The AI can stop traffic. It can never clear it.
